detailZh: 沃尔夫要求解释拉塞尔为何在“理想”的最后一圈位置下错失拉斯维加斯杆位
沃尔夫要求解释拉塞尔为何在拥有理想赛道位置的情况下，仍以0.073秒之差负于维斯塔潘、错失拉斯维加斯站杆位
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯在周五晚的拉斯维加斯街道赛道排位赛结束后拥有全场最快的赛车，但车队领队沃尔夫仍有疑问需要解答。世界冠军安东内利在Q3做出1分33秒893的最快圈速，却因更换梅赛德斯升级版ADUO涡轮增压器被罚退五位，正赛从第六位起步。队友拉塞尔未能因此继承杆位，红牛车手维斯塔潘以1分34秒151抢下头名，仅以0.073秒的优势压过拉塞尔的1分34秒224。
这个结果令人刺痛，因为拉塞尔在当晚早些时候看起来不可撼动，他在最后一次练习赛中以1分34秒041的成绩领先安东内利0.911秒。Q3中情况更加复杂，拉塞尔曾要求梅赛德斯让已被罚退的队友为他提供尾流。
然而，混乱的最后一圈出场圈让安东内利落在车阵后方，使这位意大利车手在直道上从前方车辆——包括拉塞尔——获得了价值高达16公里/小时的牵引力。
排位赛后，当被问及梅赛德斯是否本应安排更好的尾流来帮助拉塞尔争夺车手锦标赛第二名时，沃尔夫驳斥了赛道位置是罪魁祸首的说法。
“实际上，乔治对我来说拥有完美的位置。他落后前车四秒，”沃尔夫说。“我们需要查明情况，因为我认为在7号、8号、9号弯附近——是出现了失误还是发生了其他事情，说实话我不知道，但那看起来像是争夺杆位的理想位置，因为他一直是最快的。”
与维斯塔潘一同在前排上演“大戏”
即便没有拿到杆位，拉塞尔周六晚上仍将与维斯塔潘并排从第二位发车，而总冠军争夺正处于关键节点。拉塞尔目前排名积分榜第三，落后维斯塔潘17分，在两辆法拉利——勒克莱尔（第11）和汉密尔顿（第12）——于Q2被淘汰后，他迎来了大幅追分的绝佳机会。
前排对手之间的紧张气氛已经升温。三练尾声，维斯塔潘在超越梅赛德斯后于14号弯减速，两人轮对轮缠斗在一起，荷兰人在车队无线电中抱怨拉塞尔“把我挤到了护栏上”。赛后审查后，国际汽联赛事干事就这次冲突向维斯塔潘发出警告。
当被问及两人并排冲向1号弯时他预期会发生什么，沃尔夫并没有淡化火药味十足的可能性。
“嗯，就电影而言，如果他们试图一起通过前几个弯道，我们可就要好好看着了，”沃尔夫说道。
detailEn: Toto Wolff wants answers after George Russell misses Vegas pole despite “ideal” final-lap position
Toto Wolff wants answers after George Russell misses Las Vegas GP pole by 0.073s to Max Verstappen despite ideal track position
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Mercedes left Friday night qualifying at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit with the fastest car on track, yet team principal Toto Wolff still had questions to answer. World champion Kimi Antonelli topped Q3 with a 1m33.893s, only to drop to sixth on the grid due to a five-place penalty for taking Mercedes’ updated ADUO turbocharger. Instead of team-mate George Russell inheriting pole, Red Bull’s Max Verstappen snatched top spot with a 1m34.151s - edging Russell’s 1m34.224s by just 0.073 seconds.

The result stung after Russell had looked untouchable earlier in the evening, topping final practice with a 1m34.041s that put him 0.911s clear of Antonelli. Complicating matters in Q3, Russell had asked Mercedes for a slipstream from his already-penalised team-mate.
Instead, a messy final out-lap left Antonelli trailing the pack, allowing the Italian to pull a tow worth up to 16 km/h down the Strip straight from cars ahead—including Russell.
Asked after qualifying whether Mercedes should have orchestrated a better tow to aid Russell’s fight for second in the Drivers’ Championship, Wolff dismissed track positioning as the culprit.

"Actually, George for me had the perfect position. He was four seconds behind the car in front," Wolff said. "We need to find out because I think there was some kind of Turn 7, 8, 9 - whether there was a mistake or something else happened, I don’t know, to be honest, but it looked like the ideal position for a pole lap because he was quickest all the time."
Setting up front-row “cinema” with Verstappen

Even without pole, Russell lines up second alongside Verstappen on Saturday night with major championship stakes on the line. Sitting third in the standings and 17 points behind Verstappen, Russell has a prime chance to make serious ground after both Ferraris - Charles Leclerc (11th) and Lewis Hamilton (12th) - were knocked out in Q2.

Tension between the front-row rivals is already running hot. Late in FP3, Verstappen and Russell tangled wheel-to-wheel at Turn 14 after Verstappen passed the Mercedes and slowed into the corner, prompting the Dutchman to complain over team radio that Russell had "pushed me into the barrier". Following a post-session review, the FIA stewards handed Verstappen a warning for the skirmish.
Asked what he expected when the pair launch side by side toward Turn 1, Wolff didn't downplay the prospect of fireworks.
"Well, with cinema, if they try to go through the first corners together, we shall be watching," Wolff said.

法拉利遭遇灾难，他们在寒冷的条件下以及长直道上挣扎，因此查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿都在Q2中被淘汰。
这是自2024年加拿大大奖赛以来，首次没有法拉利车手进入Q3，汉密尔顿对此感到震惊，他和勒克莱尔都没有晋级。
由于皮亚斯蒂的赛程处罚，勒克莱尔将在周日的比赛中从第10位起步，汉密尔顿则是第11位。

detailEn: Las Vegas GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest but Max Verstappen on pole from George Russell after dramatic qualifying

Kimi Antonelli was quickest in qualifying but a five-place grid penalty for a new engine means Max Verstappen will be on pole from George Russell for the Las Vegas Grand Prix; watch Sunday's race at 4am (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli was fastest in qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix but a five-place grid penalty means Max Verstappen will start on pole position from George Russell.
New Formula 1 world champion Antonelli will start sixth due to a grid penalty for exceeding his internal combustion engine allocation and surprisingly went fastest in a hectic end to Q3.
The Mercedes driver only just crossed the line in time to start a final flying lap and was helped by a huge slipstream from the Racing Bulls throughout the lap to beat Verstappen by 0.258s.

Russell was 0.331s behind Antonelli but the Verstappen-Russell front row cannot be missed when the lights go out at 4am UK time on Sunday (build-up from 2.30am), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event, after the pair made contact in final practice.
Neither driver was penalised as Verstappen was given a warning for driving erratically when trying to stop Russell from gaining track position in final practice earlier on Saturday.
George Russell and Max Verstappen collided with one another during final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix
McLaren's Lando Norris will start third with Red Bull's Isack Hadjar in fourth and Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad will start in fifth, his highest career grid position.
Oscar Piastri qualified seventh but the McLaren driver has a 10-place grid penalty for exceeding his engine allocation, so will start 17th, so Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson will start seventh instead.
Alpine's Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto had great pace throughout qualifying but were caught up in the traffic chaos in Q3 on the out laps, so only qualified ninth and 10th.
Both Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc were eliminated from Q2 as Ferrari were left frustrated in Las Vegas qualifying
Ferrari had a disaster as they struggled in the cold conditions and on the long straights, so both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton were knocked out in Q2
It is the first time no Ferrari driver has reached Q3 since the 2024 Canadian Grand Prix and Hamilton was shocked both he and Leclerc did not get through.
Due to the grid penalty for Piastri, Leclerc will start 10th and Hamilton in 11th for Sunday's race.

detailZh: F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛：安东内利最快，维斯塔潘夺杆位，法拉利Q2出局
安东内利在排位赛中速度最快，但将降五位发车
维斯塔潘将在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛中占据杆位，尽管安东内利以0.258秒的优势领先
2026年世界冠军以0.258秒的优势击败了红牛车手，但由于他的梅赛德斯新内燃机，他将从五号位起跑
在维特斯坦普以1分34秒151的成绩获得临时杆位，而安东内利排名第六的情况下，但荷兰人在最后一圈未能提升成绩，给了其他人超越他的机会。
然而，只有安东内利成功击败了维特斯坦普，在终点线处以1分33秒893的成绩完成比赛——这是他今年第八次在排位赛中取得最快成绩，也是自奥斯汀以来首次。
但由于赛前的罚分，维特斯坦普将在发车线上与梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔并肩，拉塞尔原本希望得到队友的推车，但交通状况阻止了这一机会。
拉塞尔的成绩为1分34秒224，比他的首圈快了两十分之一，仅比麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯快0.020秒，因此诺里斯将在周六晚上的发车线上完成前三名。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾在Q3中排名第五，比最快的慢了0.699秒，第六名是令人印象深刻的菜鸟车手阿里夫德·林德布拉德，就在小红牛确认他将于2027年加入车队一周后。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂排名第七，但他是有五位将要接受发车位处罚的车手之一，他的处罚是10个发车位，因为更换了引擎，第八名是林德布拉德的队友利亚姆·劳森。
阿尔派恩车队组合皮埃尔·加斯利和弗朗哥·科拉平托分别完成了前十名，分别比安东内利慢了1.212秒和1.421秒，但最大的话题发生在第二节的练习中，因为法拉利遭遇了自去年伊莫拉以来首次双Q2退出的情况。
意大利车队在混乱的Q2后占据了第六排，勒克莱尔在第七弯中锁死轮胎后，中途放弃了这一圈。
摩纳哥车手随后未能进入赛道开始本回合，最终排名11位，领先排名12位的汉密尔顿，汉密尔顿在最后一圈未能提升自己的成绩。
“难以置信，”勒克莱尔表示，他的队友如果在旗杆处有所改进，本可以将安东内利淘汰出局——这位意大利车手仅以0.111秒的差距幸存下来。
汉密尔顿身后是奥迪车手尼克·胡肯伯格，排名第13位，第14位是威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·塞恩斯，他因更换新涡轮增压器将被处以10位降级。
胡肯伯格的队友加布里埃尔·博特洛托将从第15位跃升至更高位置，而第16位是亚历克斯·阿隆博，这是威廉姆斯车队在2026赛季首次在第二阶段练习中出现双车手。
拉斐尔·卡马拉在比赛初期在第一个弯道发生打滑，原本看起来将从队友奥利弗·贝尔曼的显著拖车中获益，但博尔特洛在终点线前将他降入Q1淘汰区。
这位新的哈斯车队招募者仅以0.071秒的差距未能进入Q2，位列第17，与第18位的凯迪拉克车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯相差1.163秒，比第19位的费尔南多·阿隆索领先1.180秒。
阿隆索的阿斯顿·马丁车队队友兰斯·斯特罗尔排名第20，但因为他AMR26赛车上的新能量存储和新控制电子设备安装，将面临10个位置的处罚。
因此，瓦尔特里·博塔斯将从第21位上升，他正是在凯迪拉克宣布2027年10次大奖赛冠军得主后的两天内，在Q1代表时间内速度最慢的。
贝尔曼因此是唯一一个没有完成一个完整圈的车手，因为他的赛车需要更换整个引擎，导致他在Q1的主要角色是协助Camara。
detailEn: F1 Las Vegas GP: Kimi Antonelli quickest but Max Verstappen on pole, Ferraris out in Q2
Antonelli was fastest in qualifying at Las Vegas but takes a five-place grid drop
Max Verstappen will start on pole at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix despite Kimi Antonelli going fastest - while Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton both failed to make Q3.
The 2026 world champion beat the Red Bull driver by 0.258s, but will take a five-place grid drop due to a new internal combustion engine on his Mercedes.
It came after Verstappen took provisional pole with a 1m34.151s while Antonelli was down in sixth, but the Dutchman failed to improve on his final lap, allowing others the chance to beat him.
Yet only Antonelli managed to topple Verstappen, setting a 1m33.893s at the chequered flag - the eighth time he has gone quickest in qualifying this year and the first since Austin.
But because of the grid penalty, Verstappen will be joined on the front row by Mercedes’ George Russell, who hoped for a tow from his team-mate but traffic denied that opportunity.
Russell set a 1m34.224s, two-tenths quicker than his opening lap, and was just 0.020s ahead of McLaren’s Lando Norris, who will therefore complete the top three on Saturday night’s grid.
Verstappen’s team-mate Isack Hadjar was fifth quickest in Q3, 0.699s off the pace, with sixth going to impressive rookie Arivd Lindblad a week after Racing Bulls confirmed him for 2027.
Oscar Piastri took seventh, but is one of five drivers set for a grid penalty, his being 10 places for an engine change, while eighth went to Lindblad’s team-mate Liam Lawson.

Alpine duo Pierre Gasly and Franco Colapinto respectively completed the top 10, 1.212s and 1.421s off Antonelli, but the biggest talking point came in the second session as Ferrari suffered its first double Q2 exit since Imola last year.
The Italian outfit occupied row six after what was a messy Q2, highlighted by Leclerc aborting a lap midway through due to a Turn 7 lock-up.
The Monegasque subsequently failed to make the line to start a lap at the end, eventually dropping to 11th ahead of 12th-placed Hamilton, who failed to improve on his final tour.
“Unbelievable,” reacted Leclerc, whose team-mate would have knocked out Antonelli had he improved at the chequered flag - the Italian surviving the drop by 0.111s.
Three-tenths behind Hamilton was Audi’s Nico Hulkenberg in 13th, with 14th going to Williams man Carlos Sainz, who is set to serve a 10-place drop for a new turbocharger.
Hulkenberg’s team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto will jump up from 15th, while 16th went to Alex Albon for Williams’ first double Q2 appearance of the 2026 season.

Rafael Camara, who suffered a spin at the opening corner early on, looked set to profit from a significant tow by team-mate Oliver Bearman until Bortoleto dropped him into the Q1 elimination zone at the chequered flag.
The new Haas recruit missed out on Q2 by just 0.071s to take 17th, with a 1.163s gap to Cadillac’s Sergio Perez in 18th and a 1.180s advantage over 19th-placed Fernando Alonso.
Alonso’s Aston Martin stablemate Lance Stroll took 20th, but is set to serve a 10-place penalty for a new energy store and new control electronics being fitted on his AMR26.
That will therefore bump up Valtteri Bottas from 21st, who was slowest in the Q1 representative times just two days after Cadillac announced the 10-time grand prix winner for 2027.
Bearman was therefore the only driver not to complete a proper lap, as his 35-place grid drop for a complete engine change meant his main role in Q1 was to assist Camara.

keyPointsEn: Verstappen will start on pole

items.titleZh: 安东内利因格尼襟翼违规被罚，击败维斯塔潘获得杆位
items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中领跑，但维斯塔潘因梅赛德斯车手的赛道罚分而获得杆位，两辆法拉利赛车均未能进入决赛圈。
items.originalTitle: Penalised Antonelli beats Verstappen with both Ferraris out in Q2
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在一级方程式拉斯维加斯大奖赛的排位赛中排名第一，但由于梅赛德斯车手的赛道处罚，马克斯·维斯塔潘将从杆位发车，而两位法拉利的车手都未能进入杆位争夺战。
安东内利因为在本周末使用了更新的梅赛德斯ADUO涡轮增压器而受到五位的赛道处罚，但他巧妙地在Q3中最大限度地减少了损失。
安东内利在最后几次尝试中冒险从争吵的车辆群中掉队，最终仅以几秒钟的差距冲过终点线。
但结果证明这是完美的，因为他处于理想的赛道位置，在最后一圈结束时从多辆车中获取巨大的尾流，以1分33.893秒的成绩完成。
这比马克斯·维斯塔潘快了两个半十分，但他无法在第三节的排位赛中提高成绩。
但由于安东内利的处罚，他将从 杆位起步，并与他在练习赛中发生碰撞的乔治·拉塞尔共享前两排的起跑位置。
拉塞尔向安东内利请求拖车帮助，但并未实现。
兰多·诺里斯代表麦克拉伦排在第四位，领先于伊萨克·哈吉亚和小红牛（小红牛）的阿维德·林德布拉德，后者取得了个人职业生涯的最佳第六名。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂排名第七，但他必须接受10个位置的发车位罚分。
利亚姆·劳森排名第八，领先于阿尔皮纳的皮埃尔·加斯利，后者在Q2中排名第二。队友弗朗哥·科拉平托在擦墙后完成了前十名。
排位赛最大的惊喜是两辆法拉利在Q2中被淘汰，这是自去年伊莫拉以来该车队首次未能将赛车送入Q3。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在整个FP3和排位赛中都表现不佳，看起来他可能会在比赛初期就被淘汰。
但是，队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔在7号弯出错，导致他的圈速被破坏，然后未能完成另一轮发车旗尝试，最终加入了危险区。
随着其他人的进步，这意味着勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿被降到了第11和第12位。
在他们身后是奥迪和威廉姆斯车队，尼科·胡肯伯格领先卡洛斯·塞恩斯、加布里埃尔·博托莱托和亚历克斯·阿隆。
拉斐尔·卡马拉在他的第二次F1排位赛中出局，排名第17，距离连续第二次进入Q2排位赛仅差七百分之一。
Sergio Perez在凯迪拉克车队排名第18位——这是自摩纳哥以来他最好的排位成绩——尽管他在队友瓦尔特里·博塔斯的拖车帮助下未能完成，正如博塔斯所说：“我们失去了对方。”
费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔在阿斯顿·马丁车队分别排名第19和第20位，领先博塔斯和贝尔曼，因为贝尔曼为了拖车卡马拉而牺牲了自己的排位赛，这是由于他巨大的发车区罚分。
11号查尔斯·勒克莱尔（法拉利）1分35.197秒 +0.111秒（与Q3的差距）
17号拉斐尔·卡马拉（哈斯车队）1分36.220秒 +0.071秒（与Q2的差距）
19 阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +1.251秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli topped qualifying at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix, but Max Verstappen will start from pole position because of the Mercedes driver’s grid penalty, and both Ferrari's failed to make the pole fight.
Antonelli has a five-place grid penalty for taking the updated Mercedes ADUO turbocharger this weekend, but he minimised the damage of that beautifully in Q3.
Antonelli gambled by dropping back from a squabbling pack of cars on the final runs as he ended up crossing the line with only a couple of seconds to spare.
But that turned out perfectly as he was in the ideal track position to pick up a huge slipstream from multiple cars at the end of the lap to set a 1m33.893s.
That was two and a half tenths quicker than Max Verstappen, who couldn’t improve on his second Q3 run.
But he’ll start from pole position because of Antonelli’s penalty and will share the front row of the grid with the man he clashed with in practice, George Russell.
Russell asked Mercedes for a tow from Antonelli, which didn’t transpire.
Lando Norris was fourth for McLaren ahead of Isack Hadjar and Arvid Lindblad’s Racing Bulls, who was a career-best sixth.
Oscar Piastri was seventh but he has to serve a 10-place grid penalty.
Liam Lawson was eighth ahead of Alpine’s Pierre Gasly, who had been second in Q2. Team-mate Franco Colapinto rounded out the top 10, after brushing the wall.
The biggest shock of qualifying proved to be a double Ferrari Q2 elimination, the first time the team has failed to get a car into Q3 since Imola last year.
Lewis Hamilton was struggling throughout FP3 and qualifying, and looked vulnerable to an early exit from the start.
But team-mate Charles Leclerc ended up joining him in the danger zone after he made an error into Turn 7, ruined his lap and then fell short of making the chequered flag for another attempt.
As others improved, that meant Leclerc and Hamilton were shuffled down to 11th and 12th.
Behind them were the Audis and Williams, with Nico Hulkenberg leading Carlos Sainz, Gabriel Bortoleto and Alex Albon.
Rafael Camara was knocked out in 17th in his second-ever F1 qualifying session, seven hundredths away from a second successive Q2 session.

Sergio Perez was 18th for Cadillac - his best qualifying since Monaco - even though he was left without a tow from his team-mate Valtteri Bottas on his lap, as in Bottas’s words, “We lost each other.”
Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll were 19th and 20th for Aston Martin, ahead of Bottas and Bearman, who sacrificed his qualifying session to tow Camara, because of his huge grid penalty.
11 Charles Leclerc (Ferrari) 1m35.197s +0.111s (gap to Q3)
17 Rafael Camara (Haas) 1m36.220s +0.071s (gap to Q2)
19 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +1.251s
keyPointsZh: 安东内利因使用更新版的梅赛德斯ADUO涡轮增压器而受到五位发车位罚分。
他在Q3中巧妙地最小化了罚分的影响。
维斯塔潘因安东内利的罚分而获得杆位，将与他在练习中发生碰撞的乔治·拉塞尔共享第一排发车位。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli received a five-place grid penalty for using the updated Mercedes ADUO turbocharger.
He minimized the damage in Q3.
Verstappen will start from pole position due to Antonelli's penalty, sharing the front row with George Russell.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘拉斯维加斯练习赛与拉塞尔碰撞仅获警告
items.summaryZh: 维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习赛末段与拉塞尔在14号弯并排时车轮相碰，赛会干事最终仅对其发出警告，未处以正赛罚退。
items.originalTitle: Why Verstappen escaped grid drop for Russell practice clash
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen received only a warning for his clash with George Russell in final practice at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, avoiding a grid penalty.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛第三节练习赛与拉塞尔发生碰撞，最终仅被警告。
维斯塔潘与拉塞尔在第三节练习赛末段于14号弯并排时离奇地车轮相碰，两人不得不在排位赛前接受赛会干事问询。
维斯塔潘和利亚姆·劳森此前在墨西哥练习赛中发生冲突，曾被处以正赛罚退一位；但在拉斯维加斯，赛会干事最终裁定对维斯塔潘给予警告已足够。
赛会干事解释说，“车手们讨论了关于飞驰圈准备的非正式君子协定以及在这种情况下车手之间应有的行为”，但决定“这些非正式共识对判定该事件参考价值有限”。
“决定性考量因素是两辆赛车的实际动作及其相对位置，”干事文件继续写道。
“因此，干事们审查了维斯塔潘的刹车和变向、拉塞尔的避让动作和位置选择，并考虑了适用的驾驶标准指南。
“干事们认为，维斯塔潘在刹车下变向不可预测，导致了拉塞尔不得不移向内线以避免接触的局面。
“虽然干事们认为该动作未严重到需要更严厉处罚的程度，但他们得出结论，在这些情况下刹车下变向低于预期的驾驶标准。
“考虑到事件的具体情况，赛会干事认定对车手发出警告是适当的。”
最终，拉斯维加斯事件被判定为一次简单的刹车区变线违规。
在墨西哥与劳森的事件导致发车位罚退，因为用赛会干事的话说，两位车手“的行为被认为不可接受”，而且此事直接发生在对所有车队发出警告、要求避免此类练习赛事件之后。
对于维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯三练中与弗兰科·科拉平托的阿尔派赛车发生的另一起事件，未采取进一步行动，原因是存在“减轻情节”，包括维斯塔潘在该圈早些时候遇到引擎问题，以及维斯塔潘对科拉平托超越他感到意外，因为两人都不在冲刺圈中。
在其他地方，亚历山大·阿尔本因在同一节练习中于伊萨克·哈贾尔的红牛赛车前做出“不可预测且可能危险”的移动而受到训诫。
detailEn: Max Verstappen escaped with a warning for his clash with George Russell in final practice at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Verstappen and Russell bizarrely banged wheels while going side-by-side through Turn 14 in the dying moments of FP3 and they had to see the stewards before qualifying.
Verstappen and Liam Lawson had been given a one-place grid penalty for a practice run-in in Mexico, but in Las Vegas, the stewards ultimately ruled that a warning for Verstappen was sufficient.

The stewards explained that “the drivers discussed the informal gentlemen's agreements concerning the preparation for a flying lap and the conduct expected between drivers in such situations" but decided "such informal understandings were of limited relevance to the assessment of the incident".
“The decisive considerations were the actual movements of both cars and their relative positions," the stewards document continued.

“The stewards therefore examined the braking and change of direction of Verstappen, the evasive manoeuvre and positioning of Russell and taking into account the applicable driving standards guidelines.
“The stewards considered that Verstappen’s change of direction under braking was unpredictable and contributed to the situation in which Russell had to move to the inside to avoid contact.

“While the stewards did not consider the manoeuvre sufficiently serious to warrant a more severe penalty, they concluded that changing direction under braking in these circumstances fell below the standard of driving expected.
“Taking into account the circumstances of the incident, the stewards determined that a driver warning was appropriate.”
Ultimately, the Las Vegas incident has been judged as a simple moving-under-braking offence.

The Mexico incident with Lawson resulted in grid drops because both drivers, in the words of the stewards, “behaved in a manner that was considered unacceptable”, and it came directly after a warning to all teams to avoid such practice incidents.

No further action was taken over Verstappen’s other FP3 Vegas incident with Franco Colapinto’s Alpine because of “mitigating elements”, including Verstappen experiencing an engine issue earlier in the lap and Verstappen being surprised that Colapinto was overtaking him, given neither was on a push lap.
Elsewhere, Alex Albon was handed a reprimand for “unpredictable and potentially dangerous” movement in front of Isack Hadjar’s Red Bull in the same session.
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘与拉塞尔在第三节练习赛末段于14号弯并排时车轮相碰，两人在排位赛前被叫去接受赛会干事问询。
维斯塔潘和劳森此前在墨西哥练习赛中发生冲突，曾被处以正赛罚退一位。
赛会干事表示，车手们讨论了关于飞驰圈准备的非正式君子协定，但认为这些非正式共识对判定该事件参考价值有限。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen and Russell banged wheels while side-by-side through Turn 14 in the dying moments of FP3 and had to see the stewards before qualifying.
Verstappen and Liam Lawson had previously been given a one-place grid penalty for a practice run-in in Mexico.
The stewards said the drivers discussed informal gentlemen's agreements on preparing for a flying lap but decided such informal understandings were of limited relevance to assessing the incident.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛的最终练习赛中表现最快，尽管他在最后阶段与马克斯·维斯塔潘发生了一次奇怪的碰撞。
在练习赛的最后时刻，拉塞尔和维斯塔潘在14号弯处激烈争夺，这一情况很快被裁判注意到，他们将在FP3之后调查这一事件。
维斯塔潘超过了拉塞尔，随后拉塞尔试图再次超越维斯塔潘，两人在14号弯处发生了车轮碰撞。
维斯塔潘告诉他的红牛车队，拉塞尔“把我推到了护栏上”。
FP3中不止这一起事故，裁判组还在调查维斯塔潘和弗朗哥·科拉平托的阿尔皮纳之间的碰撞事件。
罗素在本节练习中的最佳成绩1分34.041秒是本节练习和整个赛事中最快的时间，因为FP3是本周末的第一场干地练习。
世界冠军车队队友基米·安东内利以第二快的成绩完成，但比罗素慢了0.911秒。他本周末将因为更换ADUO涡轮增压器而受到五位的发车位置处罚。
在理论圈速（结合使用车手最佳的三段成绩）方面，利亚姆·劳森实际上以第二快的成绩完成，比罗素的理论最佳成绩慢0.618秒。
实际上，劳森的最快成绩实际上只排在第七，比最快的慢了1.361秒。
兰多·诺里斯的麦凯轮车队以第三快的成绩出现，慢了0.974秒，查尔斯·勒克莱尔的红牛车队以第四快，科拉平托的阿尔派车队以第五快的成绩出现。
维斯塔潘在与拉塞尔的碰撞后排在第六，领先劳森、刘易斯·汉密尔顿的红牛车队（通过几次偏离赛道的情况）、皮埃尔·加斯利的阿尔派车队和阿尔维德·林德布拉德的小红牛车队。
10 阿尔维德·林德布拉德（小红牛车队）慢了1.409秒。
20 费尔南多·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +3.208秒
detailEn: George Russell was fastest in the final practice session at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix, despite a bizarre late-session run-in with Max Verstappen.
Russell and Verstappen were fighting tooth and nail into Turn 14 in the dying moments of the session and were quickly noted by the stewards, who will investigate the incident after FP3.
Verstappen passed Russell, who then tried to re-pass Verstappen, with the duo banging wheels through Turn 14.
Verstappen told his Red Bull team Russell “pushed me into the barriers”.
That wasn’t the only incident in FP3, as the stewards are also investigating an incident between Verstappen and Franco Colapinto’s Alpine.
Russell’s session-topping 1m34.041s was comfortably the quickest time of the session and the event so far, given FP3 was the first dry session of the weekend.
World champion team-mate Kimi Antonelli was second fastest but 0.911 seconds slower than Russell. He’s taking a five-place grid penalty this weekend for taking the ADUO turbocharger.
On theoretical laptimes (combined using a driver’s best three sectors), Liam Lawson was actually second fastest, 0.618s slower than Russell’s theoretical best.
In reality, Lawson’s fastest time was actually only seventh quickest, 1.361s off the pace.
Lando Norris’s McLaren was third quickest, 0.974s off, with Charles Leclerc’s Ferrari fourth and Colapinto’s Alpine an impressive fifth.
Verstappen was sixth after his Russell run-in, ahead of Lawson, Lewis Hamilton’s Ferrari (via a couple of off-track moments), Pierre Gasly’s Alpine and Arvid Lindblad’s Racing Bulls.
10 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +1.409s
20 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +3.208s

拉塞尔的圈速为1分34.041秒，是练习赛中最快的时间。

detailZh: F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛：乔治·拉塞尔在碰撞后领跑最终练习赛
梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔在周五的F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛最终练习赛中领跑，此前他与马克斯·维斯塔潘发生碰撞
乔治·拉塞尔在拉斯维加斯大奖赛的紧张第三练习赛中与马克斯·维斯塔潘发生碰撞，作为梅赛德斯F1车手，他领跑计时表
在周四的两次练习赛都被雨水打断后，周五傍晚拉斯维加斯大道上充满了活力。唯一的剩余练习赛变得至关重要，因为它提供了进入排位赛和比赛的唯一干燥赛道，所有22辆车迅速从维修区冲出。
在14摄氏度的寒冷气温中，周四的降雨使得围绕拉斯维加斯大道的6.2公里赛道更加难以驾驶，路面抓地力极为有限。
维斯塔潘在侧滑惊险和转向机构问题中幸存，并在软胎上以1分35.675秒的成绩领跑，这是在寒冷条件下最受欢迎的轮胎，因为它更容易升温。
在比赛过半后，拉塞尔以1分35.124秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这位英国人希望以高姿态结束赛季，因为他拒绝了梅赛德斯涡轮增压升级以避免发车处罚。拉塞尔进一步将自己的基准成绩降低到1分34.805秒，但在滑溜的赛道上成为多辆赛车中找到跑道的车辆之一。
迫切需要在赛道上完成大量干净圈数的紧迫感表现得淋漓尽致，维斯塔潘和弗朗科·科拉平托在争夺干净空气的过程中几乎发生冲突。维斯塔潘的红牛车队队友伊萨克·哈达尔也为威廉姆斯车队的亚历克斯·阿隆也为处罚进行了游说。
安诺内利对维斯塔潘强行超车感到恼火，当这位四次世界冠军随后锁死方向盘并冲入跑道区域时，兰多·诺里斯掩饰不住自己的喜悦。"即时报应，太神奇了，"他在车队无线电里说道。
最大的冲突发生在练习课结束的时候，再次涉及维斯塔潘，他在直道上试图对拉塞尔使用类似的动作。拉塞尔毫不畏惧，将他的梅赛德斯赛车开进14号弯的内侧，再次超越红牛，在强行将维斯塔潘挤出赛道时发生了侧面接触。这一事件将由国际汽联的裁判员进行调查。"有趣的游戏，"拉塞尔在无线电里描述了这一事件。
诺里斯在练习课的最后几分钟几乎超越了拉塞尔，以1分35.060秒的成绩排名第二。然而，拉塞尔在最后也找到了提升，以1分34.306秒和1分34.041秒的成绩在成绩单上领先诺里斯七个十分之一。
诺里斯被他的世界冠军继承人基米·安东内利降级到第三名，而查尔斯·勒克莱尔在尝试了几个逃生区域后，滑行到第四名。
在维特斯坦普之前，科拉平托为阿尔皮纳车队获得了第五名，这条赛道应该适合恩斯顿车队的滑溜溜的赛车，正如皮埃尔·加斯利在蒙扎的惊人杆位所证明的那样。
小红牛车队的李安·劳森获得了第七名，随后是刘易斯·汉密尔顿、加斯利和阿尔维德·林德布拉德。
detailEn: F1 Las Vegas GP: George Russell tops final practice after Max Verstappen collision
Mercedes' George Russell tops Friday's final practice at Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix after clashing with Max Verstappen
George Russell collided with Max Verstappen in a tense third practice session at the Las Vegas Grand Prix as the Mercedes Formula 1 driver topped the timesheets.

After both of Thursday's practice sessions had been derailed by rain, the Las Vegas Strip was buzzing with activity at dusk on Friday. The sole remaining practice session became crucial as it presented the only dry running heading into qualifying and the race, as all 22 cars sprinted out of the pitlane in short order.
Amid chilly 14C temperatures, the Thursday rainfall only made the 6.2km circuit around the Las Vegas Strip even more difficult to drive, with surface grip extremely limited.

Verstappen survived a sideways scare and steering rack issues to lead the early running with a 1m35.675s on soft tyres, by far the most popular tyre in cold conditions as it was easier to fire up to temperature.

Just after the halfway mark Russell took over top spot with a 1m35.124s, the Briton aiming to finish the season on a high as he declined a Mercedes turbo upgrade to avoid a grid penalty. Russell further lowered his own benchmark to a 1m34.805s lap, before becoming one of several cars to find the runoff area on the slippery circuit.

The urgency to get plenty of clean laps in was on full display with Verstappen and Franco Colapinto almost coming to blows in their quest for clean air. Verstappen's Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar also lobbied for a penalty for Williams' Alex Albon.

Annoyed by Verstappen forcing his way past, Lando Norris couldn't hide his glee when the four-time world champion subsequently locked up and sailed into the runoff area. "Instant karma, amazing," he said over team radio.

The biggest clash followed right at the end of the session, again involving Verstappen, as he tried a similar move on Russell on the straight. Undeterred, Russell sent his Mercedes down the inside of Turn 14 to re-pass the Red Bull, making side-on contact as he muscled Verstappen off the track. The incident will be investigated by the FIA’s stewards. "Fun and games," Russell described the incident on the radio.

Norris initially came closest to overhauling Russell in the closing minutes of the session, settling for second with a 1m35.060s lap. Russell found late improvements too, though, to pull out a massive seven-tenth lead on Norris at the top of the timesheets with laps of 1m34.306s and 1m34.041s.
Norris was demoted to third by his world championship heir Kimi Antonelli, while Charles Leclerc skated his way to fourth after sampling several escape areas.
Ahead of Verstappen, Colapinto was fifth for Alpine on a circuit that should suit the Enstone team's slippery car, as evidenced by the Pierre Gasly's shock pole back in Monza.
Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson was seventh, followed by Lewis Hamilton, Gasly and Arvid Lindblad.
